annotations.title: French company behind a website (domain to SIREN + health check)

description: Find the French company behind a website (SIREN from its legal notice pages) and get its full health check. Give the bare domain name (e.g. www.example.fr), not a URL or an IP address. Reads the home page and up to 3 legal notice / terms pages (robots.txt respected), extracts SIREN / SIRET / RCS / VAT numbers ranked by confidence, and returns the company_health_check report of the best match. Not charged if no SIREN is found or the site is unreachable. Price: $0.03 per call, paid in USDC on Base via x402. You are not charged when the call fails or finds nothing.

domain.description: Domain name of a French company website, e.g. legifrance.gouv.fr or www.example.fr (https:// and path are ignored)
